description: This Java class 'MessageOnlyLogFilter' implements the 'LogNode' interface to filter log messages, only passing the message content to the next node in the logging chain. It is used to simplify log output by excluding metadata like priority, tag, or throwable information.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that forwards only the message content to subsequent log nodes, removing all other metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that takes the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message by forwarding only the message content to the next node.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
